description: Verifies idempotent duplicate re-import keyed by (producer_id, stream, snapshot_sequence) and rejection of conflicting manifests on an existing sequence.

steps.description: Exact duplicate re-import of snapshot_sequence=1 is an idempotent no-op.
Conflicting manifest with different manifest_digest at snapshot_sequence=1 is rejected.
Historical exact re-delivery of already-committed snapshot_sequence=1 remains DUPLICATE_NOOP.
